name: The Library of Echoing Shadows
description: A vast library where shadows cast by books come alive and tell stories, creating silhouettes that dance along the walls.
prompt: An infinite library with towering bookshelves stretching into darkness. Each book casts a shadow that moves independently, telling its own story through elegant silhouette animations on parchment-colored walls. Warm golden lamp light illuminates floating dust motes. Deep mahogany shelves contrast with ethereal blue shadows. Dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, mysterious atmosphere, ultra-realistic textures.
caption: Every book here tells two stories - the one inside...and the shadow that dances outside. 📚🌑
